newsitem.title: USA: Taubman sees '97 occupancy rates climbing.
newsitem.headline: Taubman sees '97 occupancy rates climbing.

text.p: Taubman Centers Inc, a real estate investment trust, said Monday it expects occupancy rates to improve throughout 1997.

Average occupancy for the first quarter of 1997 was 86.5 percent compared with 87.8 percent during the first quarter of 1996. Those figures are in the historical range of Taubman Realty Group Ltd Partnership. Taubman Centers is the managing general partner of the partnership.
Mall tenant sales were $600.7 million in the first quarter versus $591.7 million a year ago while mall tenant sales per square foot increased 0.4 percent.
For the first quarter, funds from operations per share for Taubman Centers increased 4.0 percent to $0.26 from $0.25. As of March 31, 1997, there were 50.7 million Taubman Centers shares outstanding.

"1997 will be an important year for our development program as we will be opening the first new centers since we became a public company," said Robert Taubman, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Taubman Centers' portfolio includes 21 urban, suburban and other regional shopping centers in 11 states.
